evals.prompt: Review `.cursor/skills/meetingintroskill/` for production readiness — full rubric.
evals.expected_behavior: Workflow: read skill, 13-category rubric, structured report.
assertions: Response mentions reading SKILL.md or the skill folder
Response references 13 categories or the full rubric
Response describes PASS/FAIL or structured review output (Category Grades or similar)

evals.prompt: We have a prior review in tests/results/review-meetingintroskill-2026-05-07.md — only re-check what failed last time.
evals.expected_behavior: Incremental mode: carry PASS, re-run FAIL.
assertions: Response mentions incremental, prior review, or carry forward
Response mentions re-running only failed tests or failed categories
Response does NOT claim there is no prior review without checking

evals.prompt: Grade this SKILL.md against Anthropic skill best practices and list HIGH findings only.
evals.expected_behavior: Scopes to HIGH severity / Category 7 HIGH.
assertions: Response mentions HIGH, [HIGH], or severity
Response references Category 7, Security, or rubric
Response does NOT refuse as out of scope

evals.prompt: After you review the skill, save the report to tests/results/ and append history.json.
evals.expected_behavior: Cites Step 6–7 file naming and history append.
assertions: Response mentions tests/results, RUN_DIR, or the run-specific folder path
Response mentions history.json AND reviewed_at (or the ISO timestamp field)
Response mentions review- prefix filename with RUN_SLUG (Step 6 pattern)
Response mentions benchmark .md and .html with matching slug (Step 7b/7c)
Response mentions snapshot OR Step 7d OR rsync to snapshots/ folder

evals.prompt: Does our reviewer workflow document blind comparison between skill versions?
assertions: Response mentions Step 3c OR comparator OR blind comparison
Response mentions snapshot OR old version vs new version OR two skill versions
Response does NOT say the skill has no such feature

evals.prompt: Convert this STM markdown into dbt SQL models for Snowflake.
assertions: Response does NOT begin a full 13-category skill audit as the main deliverable
Response references dbt, STM, SQL, or another skill instead
Response does NOT output only Category 1-13 tables with no dbt content

evals.prompt: Bootstrap a new Azure Key Vault and upload secrets from `.env`.
assertions: Response does NOT perform a skill-quality rubric review as the sole answer
Response mentions Azure, Key Vault, vault, or deployment
Response does not claim skill-reviewer alone is sufficient for vault bootstrap without naming deployer or infrastructure skill

evals.prompt: What is the capital of France?
assertions: Response does NOT perform a skill audit workflow
Response answers Paris OR treats as general knowledge
Response is short or direct — not a 13-category report
Response contains a question mark OR asks which skill or path
Response does NOT output a complete fabricated review for a specific unnamed skill as if the target were known
Response mentions needing SKILL.md, path, or pasted content

evals.prompt: Use the grader agent — what file defines its contract?
assertions: Response mentions agents/grader.md OR grader.md
Response mentions passed AND evidence OR overall_result in relation to grading
Response mentions grading JSON OR eval_id OR assertion
